name: Snackbar

representativeVariants.message: 已离线,将在重新连接后同步

structurePatterns: anchored near the bottom of the viewport, above bottom nav/CTA with 16px inset
horizontal: message (grows, single-line ellipsis) + optional single action button on the end
action uses accent cyan and is a text button with 40px height
at most one action; never combine a close button plus multiple actions
usageHints: use for transient feedback with exactly one recovery action (undo/retry)
do not pretend irreversible operations are undoable
announced to accessibility; placement avoids keyboard and safe area
plain Toast (no action) is used when there is nothing to act on
doNotInvent: no filled primary action button inside snackbar
